speaker: Girl's mother
original_jp: 貴方も祈りを〓げてはいかがですか？心が落ち着きますよ
original_en:
Would you care to offer prayer?
It will put your soul at ease.

speaker: Girl's mother
original_jp: 祈りさえ〓げていれば アリーシャ王女のような悲〓はきっと起こりません…
original_en:
As long as we pray, a tragedy like
Princess Alicia's won't happen again.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: 〓る前には必ずお祈りしろって母さまがうるさくて仕方ないの <PART> …何でも この国の王女様は悪魔〓きだったそうでその反動で余計信心深くなっちゃったみたい <PART> それが〓因かどうかは知らないけど王女様は何年か前に亡くなってしまったわ
original_en:
She's always on my case about
praying before bedtime. <PART>
---
My mother turned into a religious zealot
after a demon possessed the princess here. <PART>
---
The princess eventually died, but I'm not
sure demonic possession was the cause...

speaker: Girl
original_jp: 亡くなられた王女様って 一人なのに誰かと話していたり 変な事を言ったり… <PART> とにかく 何か色々とおかしかったって聞いているわ
original_en:
The princess used to talk when no one was
around her and say strange things... <PART>
---
From what I've heard, something
just wasn't right with her.
